name: A failure that really stings gets a swear
case: Boop is already fed up, grumpy, after a failed check. The agent works for four minutes, its tests fail again, and then the whole turn fails (a long turn, not a very long one, which would make Boop sad). That's a failure that really stings: Boop makes a grumpy or irritated face, played as a failure, and swears at it ('Shit', 'Fuck', 'Damn', 'Crap' or 'Shiba'), or at least says a grumbling phrase ('Mamma mia', 'Oh, come on'). It swears at the situation, never at the person.
why: characters/boop/steering/personality/boop.md: a failure that really stings, in an irritated or grumpy face, gets a swear; say.kind's swear is a failure that really stings; a swear only on a failed turn, and irritated and grumpy faces have them

steps.prompt: get the checkout flow passing again

expect.said: Shit|Fuck|Damn|Crap|Shiba|Mamma mia|Ay ay ay|This thing|Bruh moment|Rude machine|Yare yare|Oh, come on
